attributes.powers:
For your combat check, bury this card to roll 1d6 plus a number of d6 equal to the scenario's adventure deck number; you may additionally discard a spell to add your Arcane or Divine skill.

You may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 10 check to recharge this card instead of burying it.
